description: Project-authored exact-answer smoke fixture, not a capability benchmark. Reuse unchanged across HF/GGUF. No training examples.

messages.content: What is 17 + 25? Reply with only the integer.
What is one quarter of 80? Reply with only the integer.
What is the capital of France? Reply with only the city name.
Complete the sequence: 2, 4, 8, 16, ... Reply with only the next integer.
A 2 kg object accelerates at 3 m/s^2. What is the net force in newtons? Reply with only the number.
An object travels 100 meters in 20 seconds at constant speed. What is its speed in m/s? Reply with only the number.
What is the SI unit of energy? Reply with only the unit name.
Is the electric charge of an electron positive, negative, or zero? Reply with only one of those words.
